title: An EmDash chat update is recorded with its entry as target and named in Site changes
steps: Common setup (tests/regression/README.md § Common setup): ORIGIN (= O), COOKIE_DOMAIN, PG, WEB, DSH, A and seat A's cookie COOKIE_A, pq (SELECT/WITH only). Case variables: KEY and LABEL = site key and container prefix of an EmDash site where seat A is owner (e.g. scv2em.scv2.tracy.test / scv2em); RUN=$(date +%s).

Check the build: docker exec $DSH grep -c 'emdashWriteTarget(' /desk-home/profiles/native/node_modules/@tracy/dsh-site-tools/lib/index.js and docker exec $WEB grep -c 'writeTargetOf(body?.target)' /opt/tracy-web/src/sites/route.js must each print a number >= 1; otherwise stop with BLOCKED note image-older-than-1bf428e65.

Define em() { docker exec -w /app $LABEL-web-1 node -e 'const {DatabaseSync}=require("node:sqlite");const d=new DatabaseSync("/app/data/data.db",{readOnly:true});console.log(JSON.stringify(d.prepare(process.argv[1]).all()))' "$1" 2>/dev/null; } (read-only; if node:sqlite is missing use new (require('better-sqlite3'))('/app/data/data.db',{readonly:true})).

Browser: run chrome-watch --status and start chrome-watch if nothing serves 127.0.0.1:9222; connect Playwright (repo copy node_modules/.pnpm/playwright@1.63.0) with chromium.connectOverCDP('http://127.0.0.1:9222'), never chromium.launch(); use a NEW context {locale:'en-US', colorScheme:'light', viewport:{width:1440,height:1000}, reducedMotion:'no-preference'} with cookie {name:'tracy_sess', value:COOKIE_A, domain:COOKIE_DOMAIN, path:'/', httpOnly:true}; never close a page, a context or the browser (let the script exit).
In the new context page.goto(ORIGIN+'/'+KEY) and wait (<= 90 s) until page.url() contains '/s/session-' and the first [data-composer-input='true'] is visible.

Fixture: POST_ID = id from em "select id from ec_posts where deleted_at is null and title like 'REG-0%' order by id desc limit 1". If empty: set T0=$(pq "select now()"); send 'Create a new draft post (do not publish it) with the exact title: REG-008-' + RUN + '-base. Use tracy_emdash content_create. Change nothing else.' (README § Send a chat message: box = page.locator("[data-composer-input='true']").first(); await box.fill(text); wait (<= 10 s) until box.textContent() === text, else fill once more, still different → BLOCKED note composer-rejected-text; box.press('Enter'); wait (<= 15 s) until box.textContent() === '', else BLOCKED note composer-did-not-send; never click, Meta+A, Backspace, page.keyboard.insertText in one go: the composer drops the text, 7/7 on scv2 03/10); poll pq "select turn_id, state from site_turn where site_key='$KEY' and actor='$A' and opened_at > '$T0' order by opened_at desc limit 1" every 5 s until its state is not 'open' (at most 10 min, else BLOCKED note turn-open-timeout); then POST_ID = em "select id from ec_posts where title='REG-008-$RUN-base' and deleted_at is null"; still empty → BLOCKED note agent-did-not-edit.

Set T0=$(pq "select now()"); send 'Change the title of the EmDash post with ID ' + POST_ID + ' to exactly: REG-008-' + RUN + '-edited. Use tracy_emdash content_update on that one entry of the posts collection. Change nothing else.' the same way.

TURN = turn_id from pq "select turn_id, state from site_turn where site_key='$KEY' and actor='$A' and opened_at > '$T0' order by opened_at desc limit 1", polled every 5 s until its state is not 'open' (at most 10 min; else BLOCKED note turn-open-timeout).
Read em "select title from ec_posts where id='$POST_ID'"; a title other than REG-008-$RUN-edited → BLOCKED note agent-did-not-edit.
Read pq "select action, via, outcome, actor, coalesce(target->>'kind',''), coalesce(target->>'id','') from site_write where site_key='$KEY' and turn_id='$TURN' order by id".

Read curl -s -H "Cookie: tracy_sess=$COOKIE_A" -H "Origin: $ORIGIN" "$ORIGIN/api/sites/$KEY/activity?version=2&filter=chat&limit=50" (follow nextCursor, at most 5 pages) and take the item whose id = TURN; none → FAIL note no-row.

UI: goto page.url() with searchParams tab=tracy:changes and site=KEY; wait (<= 90 s) for [data-site-changes-v2] and until no [data-site-changes-v2] [data-reading] remains; find li.tv-activity-event[data-event='<TURN>'] (README § Find a row in Site changes: at most 30 times — row present → stop; .tv-activity-more gone → the list ended; its button enabled → click it once, never while it reads 'Loading…' (disabled); wait 2 s, then wait (<= 90 s) until the row exists, .tv-activity-more is gone, or the button is enabled again; list ended without the row → FAIL note row-not-in-list); read the textContent of its [data-cell='description'] .tv-activity-desc-text.
expect: Both build checks print a count >= 1.
If every via='emdash-mcp' row of TURN has action 'content_replace' → BLOCKED note agent-used-content-replace (that job names no single entry by design); otherwise every check below applies.
site_write has a row action='content_update', via='emdash-mcp', outcome='ok', actor=A, target kind='posts', target id=POST_ID (before #772 the same row carried target NULL: QA-A10-em r1, scv2em).
API item: origin.source='chat', description.key='resource.op', description.params.type='post', description.params.id=POST_ID (before #772: description.key='change.recorded' with params.operations=1).
API item: description.params.op='update' when every ok emdash-mcp row of TURN is content_update.
API item: effects.content.resources has an entry with type='post', id=POST_ID and 'update' in ops; effects.content.operations=0.

The row's description text names the post by its new title REG-008-<RUN>-edited and never shows the bare POST_ID (en reads 'Updated post “REG-008-<RUN>-edited”'; since #900 E3.2, a ULID is never shown — before it read 'Updated post <POST_ID>').

selectors.writeRecord: site_write(site_key, turn_id, action, via, outcome, actor, target jsonb {kind, id})
selectors.emdashPosts: ec_posts(id, title, status, deleted_at) in /app/data/data.db of <label>-web-1

fence: site-tools emdashWriteTarget puts {kind: <collection>, id} on the POST /api/sites/:key/changed report of a tracy_emdash write and the door's writeTargetOf keeps it as site_write.target, from which effectsOf builds a resource.op description with the collection singularised (posts → post).
